ped_waiting.value: 36 months of continuous coverage (modifiable via Pre-Existing Disease Waiting Time Modification option)

specific_waiting.value: 24 months Specified Disease waiting period (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, etc.)

initial_waiting.value: 30 days initial waiting period (accidents covered from day 1)

room_rent.value: Choice of Single Private Room or Sharing Room under Room Type Modification; ICU always paid up to Base Sum Insured

copay.value: Optional Co-payment (0% by default unless opted in Policy Schedule)

ayush.value: Covered up to Sum Insured in an AYUSH Hospital (minimum 24 hours admission)

daycare.value: Hospitalization of 2 hours or more covered up to Sum Insured

pre_post.value: 60 days pre-hospitalisation and 180 days post-hospitalisation covered up to Sum Insured

ncb.value: Booster+ carries forward unused Base Sum Insured up to 3X–10X; ReAssure+ triggers unlimited Base SI restoration from first claim

renewal.value: Lifelong renewability with 30-day Grace Period (15 days for monthly mode); Lock the Clock freezes age slab until a claim is paid

sublimits.value: Modern Treatments covered up to Base Sum Insured (₹1 Lakh per claim cap on a few robotic/modern therapies)
